title_en: Good News (19/20): A Farmer Invents a Water-Saving Device
note_en: 把 moves the object in front of the verb so the sentence can say what happens to it: 他把瓶底剪开 "he cut open the bottoms of the bottles." Use it when the action changes the object, so the verb needs a result or direction after it (剪开 "cut open", 倒挂 "hang upside down"); a bare 他把瓶底剪 is incomplete.
